method: All five 110dpi complete-page renders visually inspected individually. Source text also read in full; scratch PDF rebuild byte-identical.

pages_inspected.finding: Title, author/ORCID, date, abstract, claim and initial formulas legible; no clipping.
Area-theorem sums, tip-distance derivation and footer legible; no overlapping equations.
Natural-coordinate construction, continuation set and orientation readable; equation transition clean.
Remainders, exact signs and angle conclusion readable; attribution begins cleanly.
Scope/AI/no-human disclosure, all 17 bibliography entries and version/license footer readable; no clipping.
